# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 1: Espionage, Court Intrigue, Dynastic Diplomacy 2.0 & 6 Universal Cabinet Actions (oe_dip2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_diplomacy.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Dev Panel Page 75 helper: grant +60 spy network and +25 favors on our largest valid neighbor
# (falling back to largest country in diplomatic range when landlocked/isolated).
oe_dip2_dev_spy_boost = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_dip2_dev_self
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_neighbor_country = {
				country_exists = this
				is_rebel_country = no
			}
		}
		ordered_neighbor_country = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = this
				is_rebel_country = no
			}
			order_by = total_population
			max = 1
			save_scope_as = oe_dip2_dev_target
		}
	}
	else = {
		ordered_country_in_diplomatic_range = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = this
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { this = scope:oe_dip2_dev_self }
			}
			order_by = total_population
			max = 1
			save_scope_as = oe_dip2_dev_target
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_dip2_dev_target }
		add_spy_network = { target = scope:oe_dip2_dev_target value = 60 }
		add_favors = { target = scope:oe_dip2_dev_target value = 25 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Increment cumulative W1 covert/dynastic operations counter for audit telemetry.
oe_dip2_bump_ops_count = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_dip2_ops_count }
		change_variable = { name = oe_dip2_ops_count add = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_ops_count value = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Apply martial or scholarly/administrative 5-year surge matching poached scope:target.
oe_dip2_apply_poach_bonus = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:target
			scope:target = {
				OR = {
					AND = { mil >= 70 adm < 70 dip < 70 }
					AND = { mil >= 80 adm < 80 dip < 80 }
				}
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_foreign_marshal_surge years = 5 mode = replace }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_foreign_talent_surge years = 5 mode = replace }
	}
}

# Country scope. Clean up stale espionage/dynastic penalties and refresh diplomatic corps standing.
oe_dip2_clear_stale_scandals = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dip2_cipher_scandal }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_dip2_cipher_scandal
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dip2_cipher_compromised }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_dip2_cipher_compromised
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dip2_dynastic_rift }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_dip2_dynastic_rift
	}
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_corps_audited_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
}

# Character scope. Safely return a royal hostage to their home realm and clear hostage state.
oe_dip2_return_hostage_home = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_dip2_royal_hostage_char }
		remove_character_modifier = oe_dip2_royal_hostage_char
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_dip2_hostage_home }
		var:oe_dip2_hostage_home ?= { save_scope_as = oe_dip2_ret_home }
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:oe_dip2_ret_home
				scope:oe_dip2_ret_home = {
					country_exists = this
					num_locations > 0
				}
			}
			move_country = scope:oe_dip2_ret_home
		}
		remove_variable = oe_dip2_hostage_home
	}
}
